meta.name: Omnix system map
meta.purpose: Orientation for an AI agent before changing Omnix: which node owns a behavior, what it talks to, which invariants and tests apply, and how the main request paths flow.
how_to_use: Do not read this file whole. Ask scripts/system_map.py: owner <path>, node <id>, flow <id>, flows, nodes, search <text>.
Find the owner of a file: longest matching prefix in path_index, else search nodes[].paths and key_files.
Before editing a node: read its docs, honor its invariants, run its tests; check edges into it for callers.
Flows are ordered steps; each step names the node, what happens there, the edge used to arrive (from/edge) and the files to read.
depends_on/uses/mounts edges are derived from the feature catalog and feature.py; calls/http/websocket/sse/sql edges are runtime traffic read from the code.
src/tests/scripts/test_system_map.py keeps this file a fresh build with every cited path present; regenerate with python scripts/system_map.py build.

edge_kinds.hosts: Desktop shell hosts the web app

global_invariants: PostgreSQL is the only structured-data authority; browser state is presentation only.
Long-running work goes through the shared job system; outputs through the shared asset model; push through the shared event stream.
Use the shared provider/model facade and settings registry; register agent/tool authority in the canonical capability system.
Modules import each other only through declared contracts in the depends_on direction; an app never imports another app (ADR-0016).
Model output is evidence or a proposal; deterministic Omnix code owns authority, state changes and completion.
Schema changes need a forward migration + persistence tests; backend contract changes need regenerated web API types.

validation.lint: ruff check <changed-python-paths>; python scripts/architecture_lint.py (reads git-tracked files: stage new files first)
validation.web: npm --prefix web run test -- <focused-test>; npm --prefix web run build
validation.api_contracts: npm --workspace @omnix/web run api:generate; npm --workspace @omnix/web run api:check
validation.postgres_tests: Set OMNIX_TEST_DATABASE_URL literally to a scratch DB on the 16432 container; never the live 5432 DB.

nodes.label: Desktop app
nodes.summary: Electron shell that hosts the web app and boots/supervises the Python services. Installers publish as GitHub releases (unsigned).

nodes.label: Web app shell
nodes.summary: React 19 + Vite 7 SPA. modulesManifest.ts registers 19 workspace modules; routes, nav, view-API scope and runtimes derive from it. ModuleWorkspace lazy-loads; viewRuntime starts only the active module's controllers.
invariants: One browser app; never add a second frontend framework.
Browser state is presentation only; backend owns domain truth.

nodes.label: Chat workspace
nodes.summary: /chatbot: chats, characters, Live Chat calls (voice, portrait video, group calls with up to four guests), memory tab, generative UI, agent runs.

nodes.label: RPG workspace
nodes.summary: /rpg: campaign play, World Forge, maps, game-master panel. Backend modules: rpg, hermes.

nodes.label: Trading workspace
nodes.summary: /trading: charting terminal (Lightweight Charts, TradingView-parity), scanners, alerts, catalysts, research.

nodes.label: Media studios
nodes.summary: Storyteller, Audiobook, Podcast, Voice, Voice Cloning, STT, Image Generation, Dubbing workspaces. Job progress is polled (Audiobook: react-query refetchInterval 3-5 s; Image Generation: 1.5 s while a job is active). Image Generation also listens to /events, through its own EventSource, to invalidate its job and asset queries. Storyteller follows its story job on the shared /events stream (useJobEventRefresh: job.running shows writing..., job.completed shows the page) and polls once a second only while that stream is closed (useStoryJob.ts). Podcast's live avatars speak the preview through the Chat workspace's TTS socket and portrait link (assistant workspace/character-speech-player.ts, portrait/CharacterStage.tsx; avatar socket ?character_id=).

nodes.label: Platform views
nodes.summary: Providers, Models, Jobs, Assets, Reports, Settings, Setup, Diagnostics.

nodes.label: Typed API client
nodes.summary: Transport + kernel client. Each feature calls the gateway through features/<name>/api/gateway.ts with schemas from its generated.ts (from the gateway OpenAPI + route-owners.json).
invariants: Refresh generated API artifacts in the same change as a backend contract change (npm --workspace @omnix/web run api:generate, then api:check).

nodes.label: Event client (SSE)
nodes.summary: Consumes the gateway /events stream (IDs + heartbeats) and invalidates TanStack Query caches; useJobEvents for job progress. A refetch trigger only: content comes from the REST reads. Used by chat (useChatJob.ts, 1 s polling when the stream is closed) and the platform jobs view; Image Generation opens its own EventSource.

nodes.label: Launcher
nodes.summary: Operator launcher/dashboard: runs release migrations, then starts and supervises the gateway and GPU services from code-defined ServiceSpecs (service_manager.py); startup-critical services first, the rest (TTS, STT, portrait) deferred to a background thread. launcher.toml only configures interpreters. The gateway, not the launcher, starts the job worker.

nodes.label: FastAPI gateway
nodes.summary: Browser-facing API (app.composition.gateway.main:app). Mounts every feature's routers, kernel routes (chat, jobs, assets, events, replay), websockets. Serving roles own request-driven chat dispatch (in-process _ChatGenerationDispatcher threads). The background role (OMNIX_GATEWAY_BACKGROUND_ROLE: worker by default, or api / scheduler / job_worker) decides whether this process also runs schedulers, the outbox relay and recovery; scripts/run_omnix_gateway.py starts the local job worker.
invariants: Never block the gateway event loop (trading jobs run on their own loop thread).
Ingress allowlist is shared with the Vite proxy.

nodes.label: Job worker pools
nodes.summary: Standalone durable job workers (python -m app.composition.worker), started as a child by scripts/run_omnix_gateway.py. Feature BackgroundWorkers that require run_job_workers (audiobook, RPG, agent runtime, voice automation and engine swaps) run only here. Claim registered job types with SKIP LOCKED + per-attempt lease tokens; bounded resource pools. Runs job pools only: schedulers, the outbox relay and recovery belong to the gateway's background role (OMNIX_GATEWAY_BACKGROUND_ROLE, default worker).
invariants: Durable leases fence stale completion; recovery finalizes abandoned work once.

nodes.label: Runtime kernel
nodes.summary: Immutable RuntimeConfig -> RuntimeCapabilities (serve_api, run_chat_dispatch, own_background_runtime, run_recovery, run_schedulers, run_job_workers, run_local_tts, use_remote_tts). Feature catalog resolves enabled features and their depends_on.
invariants: Process capabilities never expand agent or trading authority.
Explicit composition; no runtime patching (ADR-0014/0015).
Modules import each other only through declared contracts in the depends_on direction (ADR-0016).

nodes.label: Security & auth
nodes.summary: Sign-in (accounts, guests, invites, Google) on by default; request guard, rate limits, run tokens, URL policy, keychain/secret stores, service credentials.
invariants: Secrets live in credential/env stores, never browser state or committed defaults.

nodes.label: Chat
nodes.summary: Sessions/messages, admission, durable generation jobs, compaction, context budget, generative UI, assist modes, live-call actions/greeting/tasks/proactive lines, the post-call recap job, camera and screen glances, overlap judge.
invariants: Recovery finalizes an abandoned chat generation once.
Chat asks the agent runtime about a typed turn only through turn_routing.route_typed_turn, which owns the turn deadline, the routing context and the routing metadata kept on the user message.

nodes.label: Live voice (calls)
nodes.summary: Live Chat calls. Prompt pipeline (profile -> spoken style -> companion context -> cache -> dependency timings), LLM routing/stream, TTS lane with speculative phrases and silent-take retry, PCM/avatar websockets, call roster, portrait link, release gates.
invariants: The voice is never held up by the portrait (bounded queue; drop and mark degraded).
Do not restart services during a live call.

nodes.label: Voice
nodes.summary: TTS engines and swap controller, model packs/installs, voice design/clone, transcription, export, TTS PCM websocket, STT proxy (browser speech through the gateway; injects the account voiceprint and call names, and writes a heard call name back as the name). The shared cast speech the RPG and Storyteller call (Storyteller roadmap ST-4.0/4.1): voice_casting.match_voices casts speakers by description words with a caller's seeded tie-break; speech_service plans tagged lines into sentences (240 characters) and speaks one sentence per POST as streamed PCM16, retrying the first piece once when the TTS is saturated, caching whole sentences only through the caller's cache port (rpg_speech_audio, story_speech_audio) and never a runaway take.
invariants: Sidecar credentials stay server-side; a browser-sent speaker_profile is dropped.

nodes.label: Characters
nodes.summary: Character profiles, avatars (Live2D, visemes, avatar generation), voice consent, live-call profile and rendering.

nodes.label: Assistant memory
nodes.summary: Memory v2 (authoritative): structured extraction, consolidation, conversation readings, scene memory, recall into prompts, Memory tab management. On for every character and the System Assistant.
invariants: Rebuilds delete what the plan omits; verify after real turns.

nodes.label: Companion activity
nodes.summary: Presence, initiative, cognition, embodiment and delivery quality for companions; reducer-owned state.

nodes.label: Assistant tools
nodes.summary: Governed tool adapters: browser, Gmail, Calendar, Contacts, GitHub repo, Kasa/home, MCP, Hermes bridge. Gate, owner grants, proposals, ledger.
invariants: Integrations enter through this policy layer; never raw credentials or host access to the model.

nodes.label: Agent runtime
nodes.summary: Semantic routing (CHAT/WORKFLOW/AGENT), planning, TaskGraph, capability/resource grants, workspace isolation, Pi runtime with broker/guard extensions, evidence, acceptance, coding quality, independent review.
invariants: Profiles are ceilings, not grants.
Approval policy never expands issued capabilities.
Coordinator/reviewer/subagent authority is explicitly narrowed.
Durable PostgreSQL state decides recovery-sensitive lifecycle.
Evidence binds to subject/task revision/workspace state.
LLM output is evidence or a proposal; Omnix code owns authority and completion.
A run ends only through run_settlement (fail_run / complete_run / cancel_run), which writes through update_state so lease fencing and the revision check still apply.

nodes.label: Research
nodes.summary: Quick search (inline in a chat turn) and deep research (a durable job: planner, extraction, validated synthesis; the adversarial gate is a test-time evaluation), outbound web policy, source store, retention.

nodes.label: Image
nodes.summary: Image jobs and providers, Flux pipeline loading, explicit download/load/unload (service availability separate from GPU residency), reference assets.

nodes.label: Character interactions
nodes.summary: Group calls: up to four guests; the floor decides which character answers and lets characters join in.

nodes.label: Desktop companion
nodes.summary: Screen observation, attention, commentary and shadow watch for the desktop companion.

nodes.label: RPG engine
nodes.summary: Deterministic RPG. Every state change is a turn through session/turn/run.py: rules are pure and return StateChange; only the reducer mutates; only the turn commit saves. Narrator phrases the committed outcome.
invariants: Only the reducer changes the document (AL019); only the turn commit saves (AL018).
One owning rule per mechanic (PipelineMechanic + MECHANIC_OWNERS/CHANGE_WRITES).
No string-key reads of simulation_state/runtime_state (AL020).
No world names/content in rules/world/session/narration (AL021).
No unseeded randomness, uuid4 or wall clock on the turn path (AL013).
Keep JSONB key order when caching/assembling documents.
Stored-shape change = new CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION + upgrade in session/upgrades/.
World text is untrusted; speaker secrets never reach the model.

nodes.label: Hermes (RPG edge)
nodes.summary: RPG edge to the Hermes sidecar: suggestions, sequence review, narrative research. Assistance only, never a game-state store.

nodes.label: Trading
nodes.summary: Market data (IBKR monitor), scanners/gapper discovery, catalysts, alerts and delivery, backtests, bounce model, prospective-gap handoff/climatology import, paper execution.
invariants: AI/shadow analysis is research; only deterministic strategy/runtime owns execution authority.
Never widen order authority as a side effect of research or agent changes.
Trading jobs run on their own loop thread, never the gateway's.
A monitor turns on and off through monitor_task.monitor_switch (its name, and <name>_IN_TESTS under pytest).

nodes.label: Audiobook
nodes.summary: Document structure and classification, speech plan, performance direction, render planner/cache, render, assembly and export. Its ingest, render and preview loops are a BackgroundWorker that runs only in the job-worker process; one leased job per chapter, checkpointed per span. A story handed over from Storyteller (POST /api/audiobook/projects/import-story, story_import.py) becomes a project whose source is the story's Markdown and whose spoken lines are stored by its source asset (omnix_audiobook_story_sources); Find speakers gives a line to a cast speaker the story named without a model, and sends the rest to the classifier when one is configured, to review otherwise.

nodes.label: Storyteller
nodes.summary: Story projects (/api/story/projects: a project's pages, versions, cast, notes and moves in omnix_story_* tables, workspace-scoped with RLS; trash kept 30 days by a retention declaration) and story jobs (story.generate on a project: one page per LLM call through the structured gateway (story/page_contract.py: narration and dialogue blocks, proposed characters, suggested moves; a cut-off reply is asked for again), with a per-action prompt from story/prompts.py carrying the story so far and the bible (cast and notes) as quoted data; each spoken line's speaker is checked against the cast and flagged when unknown, and proposed characters are stored as suggestions; it appends a page, or for rewrite/expand/dialogue/summarize a version, keyed by job id so a retry adds nothing; a Generate of several chapters appends one page per chapter, each opening the next from the story so far and keyed by job id and chapter number, so a retry writes only the rest). An interactive page is written from the run's latest rolling summary, its last two pages and the bible (prompts.interactive_context), so the prompt stays the same size; the visible run is one chain of parent_page_id, so undo and Continue from here hide pages and never delete them, and Keep this run saves a kept_run version. A project can carry a plan (story/outline.py: chapters of beats kept in the project's outline; an outline job plans it, the writer edits it, and a beat is drafted into its chapter as a page tied to the beat) and presets (preset notes with a tone and writing style; the one in use gives the story its tone and style, and its instructions go with every page). A page is read aloud in cast voices through platform voice (story/voices.py: the writer's or an automatic cast in omnix_story_voice_cast, sentences cached in omnix_story_speech_audio). The writer edits a page's blocks in place, keeping each spoken line's speaker; a rewrite, expansion or dialogue polish of a selected block range on one page is kept as a version with a pending selection (the range, its original and proposed blocks), which the writer accepts into that range only while the range is unchanged (the manuscript before it kept as a version) or rejects. A story exports as an EPUB, Word or PDF book (story/export.py). Also the podcast script job (podcast.generate: plan with beats -> parts that carry the points already made -> a checking pass that rewrites flagged repeats -> pacing and a quality report). Podcast research (/api/podcast/research, research:run) is one quick web search on the episode's topic, returned as source notes the producer edits before the script is written.

nodes.label: Dubbing
nodes.summary: Translate, fit and mix dubbing steps as jobs.

nodes.label: Providers & models
nodes.summary: One provider/model facade for every feature: LM Studio, llama.cpp, Claude CLI, OpenRouter, Cerebras, ChatGPT Codex, OpenAI-compatible; TTS/STT providers, Smart Turn, Nemotron EOU streaming.
invariants: Features never own provider discovery; use the shared facade.
Provider ids and llm:<provider>:<model> references are parsed only by catalog.provider_id_of and model_route (ModelRoute, model_name_of); callers do not split them.

nodes.label: Prompts
nodes.summary: Prompt registry, renderer and repository; golden file guards prompt text.

nodes.label: Capabilities
nodes.summary: Capability registry, approvals, executor, MCP policy, tool-call contract. Agent runs reach it through agent_runtime/capability_requests.py; profiles.py and resource_grants.py narrow what a run may use.
invariants: A model cannot obtain a capability by deciding it needs one.

nodes.label: Jobs & runs
nodes.summary: Shared job/run model: type, priority, resource class (CPU, GPU-LLM/TTS/STT/image), stages, progress, logs, outputs, cancel/retry.
invariants: Long-running work enters the job system, never a request handler or feature-local queue.
The worker's claim starts a job and tells the observers; a feature's run (JobHandlerSpec.run) returns a JobResult or raises a JobFailure, and the registry completes or fails the job.

nodes.label: Events & outbox
nodes.summary: Writers append to omnix_outbox_events in the same transaction; the relay delivers per-aggregate in order. Run streams and the /events SSE stream.
invariants: Use the shared event transport; websockets only for truly interactive flows.

nodes.label: Assets
nodes.summary: Shared asset/artifact model (identity, type, owning module, MIME, storage, metadata). Guarded bounded UTF-8 reads for text assets.

nodes.label: Persistence
nodes.summary: Unit of work, transaction policy, repositories, document store, retention, tenant scope, forward migrations.
invariants: Schema change = forward migration under persistence/migrations (or the module's migrations/) + persistence tests.
Preserve idempotency and recovery semantics.

nodes.label: Settings & config
nodes.summary: Settings registry (scope, persistence owner, writability, restart needs) and env variable registry.
invariants: Register settings with an explicit persistence owner; env/status settings are read-only.

nodes.label: Model catalog
nodes.summary: Local model catalog, packs, downloads, hardware checks, locks.

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.summary: Logging, metrics (Prometheus), tracing, content-free diagnostics, reports.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 17
nodes.summary: Sole structured-data authority: records, jobs/runs, sessions, campaigns, agent records, outbox. Live on 5432; tests use a scratch DB on the 16432 container.
invariants: Tests set OMNIX_TEST_DATABASE_URL literally to a scratch database, never the live one.

nodes.label: Blob & file storage
nodes.summary: Generated media, large artifacts, model weights, logs/exports (local files or S3).

nodes.label: World bundles
nodes.summary: RPG worlds as data bundles (the starter town included); community catalog in a separate repo.

nodes.label: TTS service
nodes.summary: Fish S2 Pro / Qwen3 TTS server with engine warm-up and trial takes.

nodes.label: STT service
nodes.summary: Parakeet and Nemotron EOU streaming STT, energy endpointing, speaker scoring against the account voiceprint.

nodes.label: Image service
nodes.summary: Optional image generation service; starts without weights, loads/unloads on demand.

nodes.label: Audio service
nodes.summary: Audio processing server (uploads, effects).

nodes.label: Portrait service
nodes.summary: Talking-head video: FLOAT and FlashHead Lite engines, LivePortrait idle loops, VRAM cap, stream leases.
invariants: Cap VRAM and stream large arrays; heavy loads have frozen the PC.

nodes.label: OmniVoice service
nodes.summary: OmniVoice TTS server.

nodes.label: Local LLM
nodes.summary: LM Studio (OpenAI-compatible) or llama.cpp server.

nodes.label: Cloud / CLI LLMs
nodes.summary: Claude CLI, OpenRouter, Cerebras, ChatGPT Codex, OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

nodes.label: Hermes sidecar
nodes.summary: Hermes agent sidecar (when enabled).

nodes.label: Account integrations
nodes.summary: Google (Gmail, Calendar, Contacts), GitHub, Kasa home devices, browser automation, MCP servers.

nodes.label: Public web
nodes.summary: Web search and page fetches under the outbound web policy.

nodes.label: Market data
nodes.summary: IBKR market data, Finviz gapper discovery, news/economic calendar sources.

nodes.label: GitHub main (research)
nodes.summary: Scheduled research runs publish the premarket handoff (resources/trading/prospective_gap_inbox/YYYY-MM-DD.json, by 09:20 ET) and climatology state on main. Omnix imports from GitHub, never from a checkout.
invariants: A handoff is immutable once imported; never publish an older climatology state.
